faqs.a: Early movement in 2 to 3 months, meaningful results in 4 to 6. Prague's competitive terms take longer; Brno, Ostrava, and regional markets usually move faster because proper Czech-language SEO is rare there.

faqs.q: Why can't I just translate my English keywords into Czech?
faqs.a: Because Czechs do not search in translated English. Czech morphology, colloquial phrasing, and local service terms produce keywords that look nothing like translations. Real Czech keyword research starts from Czech search data, not a dictionary.
